note: German soldier/vehicle roster, hand-transcribed by the user from the photographed character/vehicle cards into reference/character_vehicle_cards_A1/, _A2/ and _A3/ (one CSV per card). Keyed by the card's own 'Card ID' field (e.g. 'GE 33/V'). Field names are exactly as transcribed (not normalized) since cards vary structurally — a plain soldier has IN/PC/WS/MPA/Equipment/Notes plus a DIE table; a vehicle has Equipment/Notes plus an 'Act Crew' table instead; a multi-soldier group card (e.g. GE 19, Kubelwagen/Driver/Officer) has no table, just a free-text 'Stats' field covering all its roles. 'table', when present: 'row_key' names the first column (DIE range or crew count), 'columns' lists the remaining (CONDITION.../SPECIAL... or Act IN/PC/WS/DS/ACTION DIE...) column names, 'rows' is a list of {row_key: value, 'values': {column: value}}. | 2026-09-07: GE 33/V IN 2->1 and GE 53/S DIE 0-2 Condition 4 836->838, both confirmed against the ORIGINAL photographed card sheet A1 — each read off the rendered card image from Ambush_Cards_Alternative_Set_Up_version_1.pdf, correcting three cards docs/48 had listed as verified. See docs/54_CARD_AUDIT.md. | 2026-09-07: added GE 23/S, 24/P, 26/X, 27/M, 28/U, 29/U, 30/R, 31/L — read directly off reference/character_vehicle_card_Sheet_A2.jpg, which carries them but from which only cards 1-22 had ever been transcribed.

GE 32/S.Notes: Fires machinegun unless wounded or inactive and GE 47 is not. If wounded, assists GE 47.

GE 34/X.Notes: If GE 34 is killed, incapacitated, or captured, put Condition 4 into effect.

GE 35/L.Notes: When Special Reaction R is in effect, ignore self-preservation.

GE 36/V.Notes: On first turn, use Condition 1 column.

GE 41/M.Notes: When Special Reaction R is in effect, ignore self preservation.

GE 42/Q.Notes: If captured, you gain 2 VP for exiting GE 42 from the map with your squad.

GE 47/R.Notes: Assists GE 32 unless GE 32 is wounded or inactive, in which case GE 47 fires machinegun.

GE 49/T.Notes: GE 49 fires LMG unless he or GE 5 is either wounded or inactive. If wounded, GE 49 assists GE 5. On first turn, use 815. *Use for rest of mission if Condition 5 comes into effect (self-preservation still applies).

GE 54/Z.Notes: Enters open; cannon not prepared on entry. When open, three crew members visible. On first turn, use 922.

GE 55/Y.Notes: SPECIAL REACTION B: Do not move at all for the remainder of the mission. Continue to fire as called for. NOTES: Enters open; cannon prepared on entry. When open, three crew members visible.

GE 11/M.Notes: If this German is killed or incapacitated in Condition 1, put Condition 2 into effect.

GE 13/W.Notes: *Germans inside this vehicle do not use their self-preservation columns as long as the vehicle remains active.

GE 19.Stats: Driver/S: IN: 3, PC: 4, WS: -2, MPA: 4, DS: 6. Officer/M: IN: 4, PC: 8, WS: 0, MPA: 4, DS: 4.
GE 19.Notes: If officer captured, +3 VP. If questioned, conduct Event Check, then see 177. Actions for this group depend on which of the following are not active: None Inactive: 826. Officer Inactive: 826. Driver Inactive: 814. Kubelwagen Inactive: 802. Kubelwagen and One Man Inactive: 813. NOTES: Both soldiers have pistols. If Kubelwagen is searched, conduct Event Check, see 006.

GE 20/N.Notes: On first turn, use 815. Fires machinegun unless wounded and GE 21 is not wounded. Assist GE 21 in this case.

GE 21/X.Notes: On first turn, use 815. Assists GE 20 in firing machinegun unless GE 20 is wounded or incapacitated. If wounded or incapacitated, GE 21 fires machinegun.

GE 2/N.Notes: On first turn, use 802, unless Special Condition A is in effect (in which case, roll).

GE 3/L.Notes: If this German is killed or incapacitated in Condition 1, put Condition 2 into effect.

GE 4/Y.Notes: NOTES: Enters open; cannon prepared on entry. When open, three crew members visible. On first turn, use 900.

GE 5/U.Notes: Assists GE 49 unless 49 is wounded or inactive, in which case GE 5 fires LMG. On first turn, use 815. *Use for rest of mission once Condition 5 comes into effect (self preservation still applies).

GE 7/N.VP: +1 VP (+1 VP if incapacitated or killed)

GE 24/P.Notes: If captured, you gain 2 VP for exiting GE 24 from the map with your squad.

GE 26/X.Notes: If GE 37 and 50 are not in play, use Special Reaction C instead of Condition 4, 5, or 6.
